verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a state business-filing portal, which could offer batch annual reports, bulk certificate orders, or bulk data downloads, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only single-item services: one-off filings, CCFS search, individual certificates, and a same-day in-person counter. Nothing documents performing actions across many entities at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
